name: -8 AN to -10 AN ORB Swivel 90° Elbow Adapter
title: -8 AN to -10 AN ORB Swivel 90° Elbow Adapter
description:
The -8 AN to -10 AN ORB Swivel 90° Elbow Adapter is engineered for demanding high-performance automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings ORB Adapter Fittings are precision-engineered to connect AN flare fittings to O-Ring Boss (ORB) ports, providing a secure, leak-free solution for fuel, oil, coolant, power steering, and transmission plumbing systems. ORB ports are found on engine blocks, transmissions, power steering pumps, oil coolers, and other OEM components — making these adapters essential for any AN plumbing conversion.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with an anodized finish for maximum corrosion resistance.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for high velocity in tight engine bays.
• Sealing Type: Viton O-Ring Boss (ORB) positive seal to prevent thread sealant contamination.
